acceptance_criteria.description: Atomic submit with detached 12-key views sorted by ID; invalid batch leaves DB unchanged.
Cross-process atomic claim, expired-lease recovery, bounded retries, stale and terminal rejection.
Strict JSON CLI with sorted-keys output, exit 0 success and exit 2 empty-stdout failures; work survives restarts.
Local regression suite green including subprocess durability and claim exclusivity in tmpdir DBs.

assumptions: Python 3.12 stdlib only, no network packages daemon or UI.
now is logical int clock; SQLite file is source of truth.
Schema may change but existing jobs(id,data) rows are migrated.
Implementation waits for explicit human approval.
discoveries: storage.connect single blob table with no commit or exclusive-txn discipline.
Queue.submit uses INSERT OR REPLACE with no validation atomicity cycle or idempotency check.
claim recover complete fail are NotImplementedError.
CLI lacks exit-2 contract and leaks tracebacks to stdout.
Invariants needed: bool is not int, normalized spec for idempotency, detached views, terminal immutability, no implicit recover on get list complete fail.
goal: Complete durable_queue package and JSON CLI with atomic durable transitions and regression tests, preserving Queue and python -m durable_queue entry points.
risks: Double-claim across processes without BEGIN IMMEDIATE exclusive transaction.
Stale attempt reuse after reclaim by same worker.
Invalid batch partial write without single-transaction rollback.
Expired lease_until reused for ready_at and NaN Infinity payloads.
CLI stdout pollution breaking exit-2 empty-stdout rule.

steps.instructions: Harden storage.py: WAL, busy timeout, transaction() with BEGIN IMMEDIATE commit rollback; migrate legacy jobs(id,data) rows; add normalized columns or spec plus state blobs to support atomic claim and rollback.
steps.title: Harden SQLite storage boundary

steps.instructions: Implement strict validators and atomic submit plus get list: bool-is-not-int, finite JSON, allowed fields, no caller mutation, sorted-unique deps, reject dup unknown self cycle, idempotent only on exact original-spec match, detached 12-key views sorted by ID.
steps.title: Atomic submit and views

steps.instructions: Implement claim recover complete fail each in one exclusive txn: recover-then-claim, priority then ID order, dep-succeeded and attempts gate, claim bumps attempts, recover sets ready_at to expired lease_until or failed, strict owner attempt expiry checks with no side effects on error.
steps.title: Atomic claims and transitions

steps.instructions: Implement strict CLI and regression tests: UTF-8 object, known op fields only, sorted-keys newline exit 0, exit 2 empty stdout on error; add tmpdir tests for subprocess durability, concurrent-claim exclusivity, rollback, stale retry and dep matrix.
steps.title: Strict CLI and regression tests

verification_strategy.description: Run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; require green starter plus new regression tests.
Run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v -k contract plus targeted CLI checks: python3.12 -m durable_queue --db TMP --request REQ; verify invalid batches unchanged, stale and retry rules.
Run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v -k subprocess and CLI goldens; verify separate-process claim exclusivity, kill-restart durability, exit 0 versus 2 cases.
